items.summary: Recommendation: reject the proposed elevatorfriends.com readiness report and authorize no new production or queue work this cycle. Existing telemetry already covers the requested evidence classes, while analytics is not configured and revenue attribution is insufficient for financial or causal claims. Continue only existing measurement, failure-repair, and bounded revalidation work. Decision question: should this cycle remain limited to those existing workstreams?
